review:
25 Coins Grand Gold Edition is the biggest-grid entry in Wazdan's Grand Gold run of Coins games, played on 25 separate reels. Cash Infinity symbols stay on the reels to make the bonus easier to reach, and Sticky to Infinity keeps Mystery and Jackpot Mystery symbols in place until the next bonus round ends.

The bonus is Hold the Jackpot, now with a 2,500x Grand Jackpot. Cluster Collectors gather values from the grid and, with Collect to Infinity, stay active until the end of the next bonus. Chance Level lets you raise the bet to improve the odds of triggering the bonus. Wazdan rates it very high volatility with a 96.13% RTP, so expect long gaps between bonuses.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
